thread:
Marta (CS): quick capture from Aurora onboarding — finance says the invoice doesn't map to their GL. they want an on-demand per-route CSV + a sample mapping doc before renewal.
Ike (PM): thanks. paste the exact columns they asked for pls.
Marta (CS): asked columns: account_id,project_id,route_name,route_id,env,model,requests,tokens,token_cost,currency_code,normalized_cost,period_start,period_end,cost_center,customer_tag. also asked for sample row with JPY values.
Pri (Finance): yup. need `cost_center` mapped to our chart of accounts. if you can include a sample row and a one-pager mapping columns->GL codes that'd be perfect.
Jo (Eng): doable. default first iteration: ad-hoc download via UI + API endpoint. SFTP/S3 scheduled drops later.
Ike (PM): priority: CSV export = P1 (they said this affects renewal), SFTP = P2, per-team default-model = P3.
Marta (CS): also flagged embeddings staleness for their knowledge base  asked for an alert when embeddings haven't refreshed in 30 days. not blocking but noted.
Jo (Eng): we'll scope CSV export MVP: `GET /accounts/{id}/billing/export/{id}` returning `text/csv` presigned URL. sample header will be added to ticket. estimate 1 engineer, 6 dev-days + 2 QA.
Ike (PM): great. Marta can you request a sample GL mapping from the customer and attach to the ticket? we'll use it to seed the one-pager.
Marta (CS): will do. also they asked for `currency_code` and a `normalized_cost` column (USD-equivalent) and to document exchange rate source and rounding.
Jo (Eng): will include `currency_code` and `normalized_cost` and add a note in the one-pager about exchange rates (we'll use daily mid-market rates and round to 2 decimals).
NotifyBot: Ticket created: CS-7786 "Aurora per-route billing export" tags=[billing,export,renewal-risk].
Ike (PM): add enablement checklist to CS-7786: spec, sample CSV, one-pager, 30-min walkthrough with finance. Marta, can CS run the walkthrough?
Marta (CS): yes, we'll run it. schedule once beta is ready.
Pri (Finance): walkthrough helpful. we want a sample CSV row with JPY and mapping to GL-7001.
Jo (Eng): will attach CSV header + sample row in the ticket (include `currency_code=JPY` and `normalized_cost` using our conversion rules).
Ike (PM): follow-up metric: % of renewal accounts that download CSV within 14 days of availability. target 50%+ for pilot.
Marta (CS): noted. I'll include that on the renewal warboard entry.
Jo (Eng): small UX ask from the chat: add `Download CSV` button in billing UI and an API link. low effort.
Ike (PM): add default-per-team-model request to backlog as P3.
Marta (CS): final note from the call: customer wants a test CSV before GA for procurement. can we generate synthetic sample matching their schema?
Jo (Eng): yes  will generate a synthetic sample and attach.
